outcome: Effectiveness and safety of penicillin skin testing (PST) and incremental drug challenge (IDC) in pregnancy
cohort: 136 pregnant women who underwent penicillin allergy evaluation in an allergy clinic and a control cohort of pregnant women with penicillin allergy who did not undergo allergy evaluation before delivery.
finding: Penicillin skin testing and incremental drug challenge are safe in pregnant women, and most women tolerate penicillin intrapartum without adverse reactions or negative pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Women who underwent penicillin allergy evaluation did not have an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
